requirements.statement: For each complex data table that has a summary, the summary is relevant.

citations.quote: Pour chaque tableau de données complexe ayant un résumé, celui-ci est-il pertinent ?
Pour chaque résumé, vérifier que son contenu est pertinent ;

routes.statement: The summary gives information on the nature and the structure of the table.

citations.quote: Il permet de donner des informations sur la nature et la structure du tableau afin d’en faciliter l’utilisation par les utilisateurs de technologies d’assistance par exemple.
permettant d’en expliquer sa nature et sa structure

rationale.text: Relevance is judgment: whether a passage explains the nature and structure of a table cannot be decided by code. The test also applies only to the summaries of complex data tables, as found by test 5.1.1, and whether a table is a data table rather than a layout table, and whether it is complex, is judgment too (see 5.1.1). So the entry is none. axe's table-duplicate-name faults a table whose summary attribute has the same text as its caption. It is linked, although axe marks it best-practice, because it is a concrete hint about the content of a summary: a summary attribute that repeats the caption may only repeat the title. It proves nothing. The caption can itself hold the summary, as the glossary recommends for HTML5, and then a summary attribute that repeats it is still a relevant summary. The rule looks at every table element with both a caption and a summary attribute, whether or not it is a complex data table, and never at summaries linked with aria-describedby, so its scope is partial and its fault is evidence only. Applicability is judgment. Needs holds assistive_tech: the glossary counts an element with role="table" as a data table only when assistive technologies render it correctly, and requires its summary to be correctly rendered by them.

citations.quote: Retrouver dans le document les résumés de tableaux de données complexes (tels que déterminés par le test 5.1.1)
en HTML5, la seule technique utilisable actuellement est celle qui consiste à insérer le résumé directement dans le titre (balise <caption>)
le résumé doit être fourni au moyen d’un attribut aria-describedby et être correctement restitué par les technologies d’assistance.
